$appComment: Compiled rather than run through Node's type stripping: the project uses
NodeNext resolution with .js import specifiers, which strip-types does not
map back to .ts. Building first is also what `npm run typecheck` does, so

$comment: Deployment-time context, all optional. Nothing here is required to run
`cdk synth`, so CI validates the templates without an AWS account.
environment  dev | prod. Controls removal policies and log retention.
domainName   Custom domain for the frontend. Omitted uses the
CloudFront default domain, which is fine for a private tool.
hostedZoneId Route53 zone, required only when domainName is set.
certificateArn ACM certificate in us-east-1, required with domainName.
alertEmail   Address for CloudWatch alarm notifications.
